positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Collaborated in the development of several innovative pricing data workflows, employing Java and Spring for API integration, SQL for querying databases, Python for scripting, ReactJS for interactive UIs, and Kafka for streamlined data communication
• Played a crucial role in facilitating the company's transition towards a more competitive pricing model that more closely aligned with industry competitors
• Practiced test-driven development, pair programming, and working on a balanced team daily
• Leveraged Jira to efficiently generate and organize user stories and epics throughout the project lifecycle
